measurement.rect_format: [x, y, width, height], pixels; right/bottom exclusive
measurement.occupancy_rule: cell contains at least one pixel with alpha > 0
measurement.grid_basis: inferred 128px pitch, checked by visual samples and alpha occupancy across all sheets
measurement.empty_cells: All empty cells are trailing padding; no internal empty cells detected.
measurement.duplicate_rule: SHA-256 of full decoded RGBA bytes for equal-sized sheets
